_note: Per-disease image subject hints (German). build-manifest.ts uses these as the preferred motif for each condition — a thing/still-life tied to the disease, usually without people. Edit freely; re-run build-manifest.ts to apply. If a slug is missing here, the per-area fallback in build-manifest.ts is used.
